title: NudgeStreamer throttles ARRIVAL RATE, not CAPTURE SIZE; SYA NatSpec :62 restates the upstream over-claim one layer up
fingerprintBasis: sha256(src/StableYieldAccumulator.sol:contract NatSpec :60-64:documentary-overclaim-timing-throttle-restated-as-structural-capture-cap)  [entryPoint null -> legacy hash form, byte-identical to pre-entryPoint findings]
description: SYA's :60-64 NatSpec restates the upstream burst-capture claim ('the batch-minter (nudge) receives a smooth linear stream instead of a lumpy push'), which reads to an SYA integrator as a STRUCTURAL guarantee against burst capture. It is not one: the streamer caps the RATE at which value arrives at the sink, never the SIZE any single batchMint caller sweeps from it. Streaming converts an INSTANTANEOUS winner-take-all capture into a DELAYED winner-take-all capture of the same total; it does not divide the pot. Capture becomes profitable at cadence t* = n*p/r (parameter-independent).
impact: None to SYA assets or availability. The loss is to the INTENT (proportionate distribution); affected parties are honest/small batchers crowded out of the winner-take-all race.
recommendation: Soften :62 to state the streamer is a TIMING throttle with NO VALUE CAP, and cross-reference the upstream entries so a reader of SYA is not left believing burst-capture is structurally prevented.

validity.rescope: SURVIVES AS A FIRST-PARTY DOCUMENTARY FINDING ONLY, scoped strictly to the SYA NatSpec leg (:60-64). The MECHANISM leg (batchMint sweeping the sink's whole balance) is OUT OF SCOPE here and is ROUTED to phoenix-nft-staking, not filed against SYA.
validity.explicitlyNotDropped: The C4 'root cause in an OOS parent/forked contract' exclusion is a PARTIAL match only and is NOT applied as a removal -- suppressing the whole item would delete the only actionable leg.

mandatoryReportingCounterweight: MUST be reported alongside POS-001. story-026's narrow, literal goal — killing the SAME-BLOCK claimer self-rebate — IS achieved, and that is a genuine and material improvement. This finding must not be presented in a way that reads as 'story-026 achieved nothing'.
